question: Does one explicitly finite parametrized-particle calibration jointly preserve an endpoint polarization pairing, an ordered finite ghost Pfaffian line, and a same-polarization two-slab Gaussian gluing identity while leaving the lapse relative cycle unselected?

primary_sources.source: Cattaneo, Mnev, Reshetikhin, Classical and quantum Lagrangian field theories with boundary (2012)
primary_sources.used_for: the distinction between bulk/boundary BFV data and boundary pairing
primary_sources.not_used_for: an absolute measure or a lapse contour for V=0 gravity

primary_sources.source: Cattaneo and Mnev, A note on gluing via fiber products in the (classical) BV-BFV formalism (2023)
primary_sources.used_for: the requirement that gluing retain compatible boundary data
primary_sources.not_used_for: a quantum continuum gluing theorem for this toy

declared_model.endpoint_polarization: fixed x_i,x_f with interface x_m in the same x-polarization
declared_model.boundary_pairing: integral_R dx psi_out_conjugate(x)*psi_in(x) on Schwartz test functions
declared_model.determinant_line_reference_orientation: Pf(A_gh,slab_1)*Pf(A_gh,slab_2)=+1 in the concatenated declared order
declared_model.gluing_window: m>0,hbar>0,T_1>0,T_2>0; use the same +i0 Fresnel branch on both slabs

initial_lapse_relative_cycle.meaning: the calibration does not choose a relative lapse cycle, a thimble coefficient, or an above/below-origin class

assumptions: the endpoint pairing is a Schwartz-space calibration, not a physical Hilbert-space product
each finite ghost block is nondegenerate and its Berezin order is the declared convention
the interface integration and both endpoint kernels use the same x-polarization and +i0 branch
the initial lapse relative cycle remains OPEN; no Picard-Lefschetz, contour, Stokes, or global intersection data are supplied
this toy result cannot orient a continuum determinant/Pfaffian line or define a V=0/gravity absolute BFV measure

decision_table.condition: all endpoint-pairing, finite Pfaffian, nonzero-mode, orientation, and gluing checks pass while the lapse cycle remains OPEN
a zero mode, non-antisymmetric block, orientation mismatch, polarization mismatch, or gluing mismatch occurs
